opening.argument: The material is framed as financial reporting on a pseudonymous Ethereum MEV bot, its reported earnings, sandwiching activity, and effects on ordinary DEX users. The headline identifies the subject as an Ethereum bot that “Bags More Than $40 Million in Three Months,” while the accompanying text explains that the reported activity involved “using a technique known as "sandwiching" on decentralized exchanges (DEXs).” It also describes these attacks as an “"invisible" tax on regular DEX users,” emphasizing criticism and market effects rather than presenting a way to participate. Nothing supplied instructs viewers to deploy a bot, send funds, connect a wallet, or join an earning opportunity; the visible page is presented as a news article, not a deployment tutorial or participation funnel.

citations.quote: Ethereum Bot Operated by Jaredfromsubway.eth Bags More Than $40 Million in Three Months
An Ethereum bot run by pseudonymous crypto user Jaredfromsubway.eth has made $40 million in just three months by using a technique known as "sandwiching" on decentralized exchanges (DEXs).

MEV bots utilizing “sandwich” attacks basically front-run other trades, purchasing currency slightly cheaper than other traders, which results in their practices being viewed as a form of "invisible" tax on regular DEX users.
